name: vite-plugin-react-server
description: Vite plugin for React Server Components (RSC)

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:types && npm run build:vite
scripts.test:server: NODE_ENV=development NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server
scripts.test:build: npm run setup:test-fixtures && npm test test/server/build.test.ts
scripts.test:llm: rm -f build.log && npm run test:build 2>&1 | tee build.log
scripts.test:streams: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/renderStreams.test.ts
scripts.test:renders: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/renderPages.test.ts
scripts.test:html-worker: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/rscToHtmlStream.test.ts
scripts.test:large-html: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/large-html.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:metrics: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/metrics.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:hooks: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/hooks.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:inline-css: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/inline-css.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:dev-server-env: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/dev-server-env.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:rsc-server: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions react-server' vitest run test/server/rsc-server.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:client-env: npm run build && vitest run test/client/dev-client-server-env.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run test:unit
scripts.experimental:clean-install: npm install react-server-dom-esm react@experimental react-dom@experimental react-server-dom-esm --save-peer
scripts.experimental:setup: rm -rf patches/* && npm run experimental:clean-install && npm run experimental:copy && npm run experimental:patch && npm run experimental:move-patches
scripts.experimental:patch-react: npm run experimental:clean-install && node scripts/check-react-version.mjs && node bin/patch.mjs

author: Nico Brinkkemper
